name: subagent-policy
description: Makes delegating to subagents the natural move and the model and effort a conscious choice: a short guide, nudges when work in the main loop would be cheaper delegated, every Agent call naming its model and effort, and stats of what was chosen.

bigOutputChars.title: Big output (characters)
bigOutputChars.description: A Bash output in the main loop this long gets a one-line nudge to delegate that kind of reading.

readsPerTurn.title: Reads per turn
readsPerTurn.description: After this many Read, Grep and Glob calls in one main-loop turn, a one-line nudge to delegate the search.

requireChoice.title: Require model and effort
requireChoice.description: Refuse an Agent call that doesn't name both, with the criteria to choose them. Off: the guide and nudges only.
